thread:
maria: quick sync — launching the blog + webinar posts went out yesterday. seeing odd inbound routing vs baseline. dashboard here: https://redwood.app/dash/launch-posts - can we do a quick readout? :eyes:

sanjay: looked at it — impressions up 28%, clicks +15%, but MQLs are flat. suspect attribution window shift from FB -> direct. pulled cohort view.

olivia: pulling cohort now. quick snippet: `utm_source=launch-posts` shows CTR 3.1% vs benchmark 3.8%. webinar registration conversion 1.2% (target 2%).

kevin: what's the attribution window on the dashboard? last week changed default to 7d from 30d for paid channels.

maria: @kevin ah — that explains part. did we apply same change to the inbound routing ETL? @tina

tina: not yet — routing still does 30d last-touch. ops ticket open: #3456. I'm fine pushing a 7d backfill but need sign-off.

maria: decision: for reporting this week, let's present both 7d and 30d numbers. @devbot can you snapshot both metrics?

devbot: automated-metrics-bot: generated snapshots for thread 1765554321
`/snapshots/1765554321/metrics_7d.csv` 7d view, MQLs=412, conv=1.3%
`/snapshots/1765554321/metrics_30d.csv` 30d view, MQLs=598, conv=1.9%

sanjay: that gap is material. recommend we highlight attribution sensitivity in the deck and call out routing mismatch as a data risk.

olivia: will add a slide: "Attribution sensitivity: 7d vs 30d" with delta chart and note about ETL drift.

kevin: can we run a quick test — reapply 30d to last 2 weeks for just launch-posts cohort and compare lead quality (pd_sales_win_rate)?

tina: I can run it tomorrow morning. estimate 2 hours.

maria: great. for the weekly KPI review, we'll present 7d default but include 30d appendix. also request marketing ops to prioritize aligning routing ETL. assign: @tina (align ETL), @olivia (slide), @sanjay (narrative + delta numbers), @maria (presenter)

kevin: +1. also flagging webinar registration funnel — run a micro-experiment on messaging variant B for the next 48h.

olivia: noted. I'll spin variant B and wire up UTM param `messaging=B`.

maria: thanks team. quick sync done. posting notes to the deck channel and assigning follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
